hypothesis: Full-history repetition penalties can distort tasks requiring repeated tokens; neutral repetition preserves exact output while retaining natural completion.
acceptance: Every fresh task must produce its exact expected text, ignoring whitespace differences, and end naturally. Any failure rejects the candidate. Protected numerical and application cases remain unchanged.
scope: Unsplit application-quality diagnostic; higher-budget control, not distributed capacity or numerical qualification.

cases.prompt: List the integers from 31 through 45 inclusive, in ascending order, one integer per line. Output only the list.
List the integers from 73 down to 61 inclusive, in descending order, one integer per line. Output only the list.
Copy these values exactly, preserving duplicates and order, one per line. Output nothing else: maple, maple, birch, maple, birch, birch.
cases.expected:
maple
maple
birch
maple
birch
birch

cases.prompt: The invoice says: Customer: Mira. Amount: 37.50. Status: unpaid. Output only the amount exactly as written.
Read: 'Lena must not ship the parcel before approval.' Is Lena allowed to ship before approval? Answer only Yes or No.
What is 14 plus 9? Output only the integer answer.
